About.title: Mexico-based. Built for high-standard work.
About.body: Kindynos is a software studio from Mexico. We started in blockchain and crypto infrastructure, and we still live there — while also building the web and backend systems that surround it.
About.body2: We take on work where the engineering bar matters: protocols, wallets, APIs, and products that cannot afford to be fragile.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.disclaimer: This page describes how Kindynos handles information collected through kindynos.mx. It is provided for transparency and is not legal advice.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: Kindynos is a software studio based in Mexico. For privacy questions, contact us at contact@kindynos.mx.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: If you use the contact form, we collect your name, email, optional company name, and message. You can also reach us at contact@kindynos.mx. Server logs may include your IP address, browser type, and the pages you request, which our hosting provider (Vercel) may process to operate the site.

sections.title: Why we collect it
sections.body: If you email us or send the contact form, we use that correspondence only to reply to your inquiry and, if relevant, to discuss a potential project. We do not sell your information or use it for advertising.

sections.title: How we share it
sections.body: We use Vercel to host the site, Resend to deliver contact-form messages, and Cloudflare Turnstile to reduce spam on the form. We share information only when needed to operate the site, respond to you, or comply with the law.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep email inquiries for as long as needed to handle your request and any follow-up project, then delete or archive them according to our internal records practice.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal data we hold about you (including ARCO rights under Mexican law). Email contact@kindynos.mx and we will respond within a reasonable time.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This site does not use advertising cookies. Cloudflare Turnstile may set a cookie to confirm you are human when you use the contact form. Essential cookies may be set by the framework or hosting provider to deliver the page and remember your language preference.

sections.title: International transfers
sections.body: Our hosting and email providers may process data in the United States or other countries. By using the site or sending a message, you understand that your information may be processed outside Mexico.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.disclaimer: These terms govern use of kindynos.mx. Project work is covered by a separate agreement. This page is not legal advice.

sections.title: The site
sections.body: kindynos.mx is a public website describing Kindynos and our services. Content is provided for information. We may update copy, services, or these terms at any time.

sections.title: No professional engagement by browsing
sections.body: Visiting the site or sending a contact form does not create a client relationship, a bid, or a duty to respond beyond ordinary professional courtesy. Paid work starts only when both parties sign a written agreement.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not misuse the site: no scraping that degrades service, no attempts to break security, and no submission of unlawful, harmful, or misleading content through the contact form.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: The Kindynos name, logo, and site content belong to Kindynos unless otherwise noted. You may not copy or reuse them without permission, except for ordinary quoting with attribution.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.body: The site is provided “as is.” We do not warrant that it will be uninterrupted or error-free. To the extent allowed by law, Kindynos is not liable for damages arising from use of the public website.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Mexico, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Courts in Aguascalientes, Mexico, have jurisdiction, unless applicable consumer law requires otherwise.
